title: Comparison square for the characterized second localization
statement: For commutative rings R,A,B,Bp,D with R-algebras A,B,Bp, compatible B-algebra Bp and compatible tensor-algebra coefficient maps to D, assume the map B to Bp is flat. Let i be an integer and Q a cochain complex of A-modules. Use the models of [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], the scalar-extension conventions of [def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology], and derived categories of modules in a common universe. The characterization is IsSecondLocalizationMap of [lem-pc-second-localization-map], for the given flatness proof. Every D-linear isomorphism satisfying that characterization commutes with localizedComparison for every ordinary complex identification tau fixed on pure tensors d tensor x. Namely L.localizedComparison composed with H^i(tau) equals e composed with K.localizedComparison.

proof.text: Construct the B-linear ordinary coefficient chain map by transposing the R-to-Bp scalar-extension unit through the R-to-B adjunction and the compatible restriction-of-scalars composition isomorphism. Conjugate with the two ordinaryIso maps and forget to additive complexes. Prove the generator formula by evaluating the transpose on pure tensors.

Apply secondLocalization_ordinary_square to this explicitly constructed coefficient chain map. This gives the comparison square before extension to D, for the additive map underlying secondLocalizationCohomologyMap.

Prove the coefficient-complex square with ordinaryToLocalized and tau by precomposing with L.ordinaryIso and tensor induction. On b tensor x both composites send it to the same D-coefficient tensor x, by ordinaryIso_tmul, ordinaryToLocalized_tmul, hτ and the B-to-Bp-to-D scalar tower. Then scalarExtension_homology_square, localized_eq for both models, and he yield the desired D-linear square.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0DJ8 affine localization identity; Tag 06Y6 ordinary counit square; proved scalar-extension transport from the existing library

lean.statement:
theorem secondLocalization_comparison (hflat : (algebraMap B Bp).Flat) (i : ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
    (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A Bp Q D)
    (e : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (L.cohomology i) ≅
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] Bp) D)).obj (K.cohomology i))
    (he : IsSecondLocalizationMap R A B Bp D hflat Q L K i e.hom)
          (τ : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q ≅
            ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] Bp) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] Bp)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
    (hτ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (d : D) (x : Q.X j),
            τ.hom.f j (d ⊗ₜ[A,(algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
              (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))] x) =
              d ⊗ₜ[A,(algebraMap (A ⊗[R] Bp) D).comp
                (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] Bp))] x) :
    L.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap τ.hom i =
            e.hom ≫ K.localizedComparison i
